semantics.colors: All material colors are authored linear RGB, not sRGB; intensity/exposure belongs to the consumer.
semantics.sizes: Artistic world-metre envelopes per named weapon role; neither raw damage nor ABI caliber is a physical bore measurement.
semantics.lifetime: Visual fade/persistence seconds only, not projectile flight time or hit timing.
semantics.binding: Armament.cs StableId(info.Weapon): FNV32 over UTF-16, modulo 255 + 1; caliber: abs(first DamageWarhead.Damage) clamped to 65535.
semantics.integration: Foundation only. No renderer consumer or Bullet/Missile observer route supplied. Require authoritative events/positions; never infer flight from these profiles.
